When a project is the right start

You do not need a monthly plan
to make progress.

A project is the right start when there is a clear outcome to deliver: a stronger website, a better lead process, an integration between important tools, an automation that removes repeated work or a team that needs practical guidance.

01

Build

You need a website, landing page, portal, workflow, automation or connected customer process created from scratch.

02

Improve

Your current website, enquiry path, CRM process or workflow is no longer supporting the business well.

03

Connect

Information is being copied manually between your website, forms, WhatsApp, CRM, payment, calendar or reporting tools.

04

Enable

Your team needs training, a workshop or a clearer plan for AI, automation or digital-system improvement.

01 / WEBSITE & DIGITAL FOUNDATION

Website and Digital Foundation Build

From GHS 15,000 per project

A defined project to build or improve the customer-facing digital foundation your business needs to look credible, capture enquiries and support better follow-up.

Typical work may include:

  • New website or website redesign
  • Core page structure and conversion-focused content direction
  • Landing pages, enquiry forms and clear calls to action
  • WhatsApp, calendar, email or CRM lead connection
  • Basic analytics and conversion tracking
  • Mobile, usability and performance improvements
  • Team handover and practical training

Best for: Businesses with an outdated website, weak enquiry flow or no clear customer journey online.

02 / AUTOMATION & INTEGRATION

Workflow Automation and Systems Connection

From GHS 8,000 per project

A focused build that reduces manual work or connects business tools into a smoother customer or internal process.

Typical work may include:

  • Lead capture and routing
  • CRM setup or pipeline refinement
  • WhatsApp, form, email and calendar workflows
  • Follow-up sequences and reminders
  • Scheduled reporting and operational notifications
  • Payment, booking or customer-service integrations
  • A defined AI-assisted workflow or internal assistant

Best for: Teams repeatedly moving information by hand, missing follow-ups or using several tools that do not communicate properly.

Project process

Clear from first conversation
to handover.

01

Consultation

We discuss your business, the outcome you want, the tools involved and the people who will use the final system.

02

Written proposal

You receive an outcome-led scope, deliverables, responsibilities, timeline, investment, payment schedule, exclusions and any third-party costs.

03

Access and materials

You provide relevant access, content, brand assets, approvals and business context needed to complete the work.

04

Build and review

We complete the agreed work, share progress at sensible points and request decisions where they affect the outcome.

05

Testing, training and handover

We test the final workflow or platform, explain what has changed, train relevant users where appropriate and hand over agreed assets and documentation.

Project to partnership

Build first. Improve later,
if it makes sense.

There is no obligation to begin a monthly partnership after a project.

When ongoing optimisation, workflow maintenance or continuous improvement would create clear value, we will recommend the most suitable partnership level.
